description: FastAPI router module for managing user favorite recipes, including listing, adding, and removing favorites with database interactions.

methods.name: _favorite_to_response
methods.description: Converts a Favorite model instance to a FavoriteResponse schema, ensuring timezone-aware created_at.

methods.name: _recipe_to_response
methods.description: Converts a Recipe model instance to a RecipeResponse schema, including tags and timezone-aware timestamps.

methods.name: list_favorites
methods.description: Retrieves a list of favorite recipe IDs for the current user.

methods.name: list_favorite_recipes
methods.description: Retrieves full recipe objects that the current user has favorited.

methods.name: add_favorite
methods.description: Adds a recipe to the current user's favorites, or returns existing if already favorited.

methods.name: remove_favorite
methods.description: Removes a recipe from the current user's favorites.
